## Type

- [ ] Correction (factual error, stale fact, broken source)
- [ ] Research contribution (track findings, vendor map, sources)
- [ ] Technique submission (production pattern with economics)
- [ ] Framework / blueprint / synthesis change
- [ ] Site / tooling code

## Review bar checklist (all boxes required for content PRs)

- [ ] Every new claim carries a dated source link, primary sources preferred
- [ ] Vendor-published numbers are labeled vendor-published
- [ ] Volatile facts (pricing, GA status, names) carry an as-of date
- [ ] Recommendations pass the simplest credible alternative test (evidence and economics, not adoption momentum)
- [ ] Style: no em dashes, plain factual statements, GLOSSARY.md terms used consistently
- [ ] If a research track was touched: Cross-Cutting Concerns (C1 to C10) and Challenged Defaults sections remain complete
- [ ] No third-party copyrighted material committed; no confidential information
- [ ] Conflict of interest disclosed if I work for a vendor discussed in this change
